Maximum idle time between provider stream events. Without an explicit override, the default is 150 seconds, or 300 seconds for effective named reasoning effort `high`, `xhigh`, or `max` (including model defaults and runtime changes). Numeric budgets and on/off reasoning retain the base default. Explicit values always win; `None` disables idle timeout enforcement. Provider-specific service tiers may have longer automatic defaults.
